map.尚未执行，点击上方按钮开始。: Not probed yet. Enter a URL and click "Probe".
map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.输入任意 URL（无协议自动补 https://），用 fetch no-cor: Enter any URL (https:// added automatically) and check network-layer reachability via fetch no-cors or favicon image.
map.先用 fetch 的 no-cors 模式请求目标 URL 判断网络层是否接受连: First requests the URL with fetch no-cors to check network-layer acceptance; on failure falls back to requesting the site favicon. no-cors returns an opaque response, so status codes cannot be read.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「探测」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Probe" above to start.
map.no-cors 模式下浏览器隐藏响应内容，只能判断请求是否被网络层接受，无法读取: no-cors hides the response body, so only network acceptance can be judged, not 200/404 codes.
map.可以输入内网 URL，但受浏览器混合内容与 CORS 策略限制，结果可能不准确。: Yes, but mixed-content and CORS policies may make results inaccurate.
map.仅 http / https，省略协议时默认补 https://。: Only http / https; https:// is added when the protocol is omitted.
